snippet.title: Astra Bestiary Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore a savage wilderness in this creature-collecting RPG. Hatch, raise, and face unique monsters in turn-based battles as you raid ancient dungeons, overcoming obstacles and challenges. Complete the Bestiary and learn the skills of Beastmastery to raise the ultimate team.

Coming soon. Wishlist the game on steam: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3529090/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=trailer_launch

Follow on X/Twitter: https://x.com/AstraBestiary
Follow on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/astra_bestiary_game/
